description: lidcol: physically-based SuDS columns (Richards equation) coupled two-way with SWMM — v0.4.10 is a model or code deposit deposited in Zenodo by its authors Francesco De Paola, Giuseppe Speranza (University of Naples Federico II). lidcol replaces the reservoir-type LID module of SWMM with a one-dimensional column per SuDS unit in which the layer that governs the response (the filter of a bioretention cell, the substrate of a green roof, the native subgrade of a permeable pavement) is solved with the Richards equation; the other layers are reservoirs. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is MIT. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support water-network, drainage and hydraulic studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
